classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2011 10-K): Our businesses are highly cyclical, in addition to experiencing some less significant seasonal effects.; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +107% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.78; conservative 2yr -22%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.8-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2012-10-26) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (40.5% downside to Bear $32 / +-36.7% upside to Bull $34) | Adj composite 1.15 vs market 3.93: gap -2.78 [OVERVALUED] | +107% above the EPP floor $26 (6x FY12E $4.32) | Conservative 2-yr case: -21.5% total (-10.8%/yr) | At 12.4x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $71 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +23.4% and Intermediates & Derivatives +15.2% operating income in Q3 2012, forward revenues -9.9% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
